Configuration parameters for constructing a template expander instance.

## Signature

```typescript
export interface TemplateExpanderConstructorParameters
```

## Remarks

This interface defines the required configuration for creating an instance of [TemplateExpander](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/templateexpander)<!-- -->. All properties are mandatory.

The parameters provide the Liquid templating engine, substitution variables hierarchy, and logger for diagnostic output during template expansion operations.
